//: Vitest transforms .tsx via esbuild, which reads the nearest tsconfig. The root config sets jsx:'preserve' (Next compiles JSX itself), and esbuild refuses to parse that — it errors with 'make sure to not set jsx to preserve'. Overriding to react-jsx here scopes the change to the test tree so the Next build is untouched. This is why component tests could not run before: not a missing dependency, just this.
